item.title: Burnout, balance and resilience: Hard-won lessons from women in policing
item.description: From pregnancy to menopause, female officers reveal the strategies that sustain long careers in a culture that rarely slows down

item.title: Women leading the way: Real stories of law enforcement leadership today
item.description: Meet the women breaking barriers and leading departments across the country — sharing their challenges, lessons and advice for the next generation

item.title: Cleveland Police OT costs reach $27M as staffing remains below benchmarks
item.description: Forty-four officers at least doubled their salaries through overtime, inluding one officer who earned $176,000 in overtime alone

item.title: Wyo. law now allows any officer to cite truck drivers for non-English proficiency
item.description: Previously, only federally certified Wyoming Highway Patrol troopers could enforce the federal guidelines requiring truckers to be able to speak and complete logs in English

item.title: DEA, Houston PD discover 200 pounds of meth wound up in spools of rope
item.description: Video released by the DEA shows an officer demonstrating the use of an X-ray machine, which captured the bags of drugs stashed inside the spools

item.title: Bloodhounds remain vital tool as N.D. Highway Patrol expands search and rescue team
item.description: Beau, a 12-week-old puppy, is joining a band of bloodhounds who are in demand for difficult cases across the upper Midwest

item.title: 'Everybody down!': BWC shows Austin officers stop mass shooting suspect in under a minute
item.description: Austin officers arrived within 56 seconds of the first 911 call, shooting and killing the suspect after he fired at police, Chief Lisa Davis said

item.title: Video: Ohio cruiser caught on fleeing suspect's trailer during pursuit
item.description: Dash camera video shows the suspect vehicle crashing into a tree, causing the Cincinnati PD cruiser perched on the trailer to fall off and roll over

item.title: BWC: Bystander helps persuade fleeing suspect to surrender to Atlanta officers
item.description: The suspect fled after resisting officers attempting to detain him for suspected marijuana possession, resulting in one of the officers breaking their leg
